SELECT TOP 100 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept, COUNT(*) AS exposure_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS persons
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%contracept%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethinyl estradiol%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%drospirenone%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%desogestrel%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norgestimate%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%etonogestrel%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, c.standard_concept
ORDER BY persons DESC, exposure_rows DESC

WITH exposure_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(de.person_id AS BIGINT) AS person_id,
    de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
    c.concept_id,
    c.concept_name,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethinyl estradiol%' 
           AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral tablet%'
           AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%desogestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norgestimate%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%drospirenone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norgestrel%')
           AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%transdermal%'
           AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%vaginal%'
           AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%system%'
      THEN 'combined_oral_contraceptive'
      WHEN (
           LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%intrauterine%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%etonogestrel%implant%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%150 mg/ml injection%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%150 mg/ml prefilled syringe%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone 0.35 mg oral tablet%'
        OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone 0.35 mg%pack%'
      ) THEN 'progestin_only_method'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS exposure_group
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), eligible AS (
  SELECT ec.*
  FROM exposure_candidates ec
  JOIN omop.observation_period op
    ON op.person_id = ec.person_id
   AND ec.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
   AND DATEADD(day, 365, ec.index_date) <= op.observation_period_end_date
  WHERE ec.exposure_group IS NOT NULL
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT person_id, exposure_group, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY person_id, exposure_group
), mutually_exclusive AS (
  SELECT fe.*
  FROM first_exposure fe
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM first_exposure other
    WHERE other.person_id = fe.person_id
      AND other.exposure_group <> fe.exposure_group
      AND ABS(DATEDIFF(day, fe.index_date, other.index_date)) <= 365
  )
), outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    me.person_id,
    me.exposure_group,
    MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(cc.concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embol%' OR LOWER(cc.concept_name) LIKE '%deep vein thromb%' OR LOWER(cc.concept_name) LIKE '%deep venous thromb%' OR LOWER(cc.concept_name) LIKE '%venous thromboembol%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vte_12mo,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(cc.concept_name) LIKE '%migraine%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS migraine_12mo
  FROM mutually_exclusive me
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON CAST(co.person_id AS BIGINT) = me.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= me.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 365, me.index_date)
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept cc ON cc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY me.person_id, me.exposure_group
)
SELECT
  exposure_group,
  COUNT(*) AS n_people_with_12mo_followup,
  SUM(vte_12mo) AS vte_people,
  CAST(1000.0 * SUM(vte_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS vte_per_1000_12mo,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(vte_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS vte_percent_12mo,
  SUM(migraine_12mo) AS migraine_people,
  CAST(1000.0 * SUM(migraine_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS migraine_per_1000_12mo,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(migraine_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS migraine_percent_12mo
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY exposure_group
ORDER BY exposure_group;
